title: "Code style divergence in file" in colcon test: ament_uncrustify --reformat, Humble vs Jazzy uncrustify, cpplint copyright and offline xmllint in ament_cmake packages, measured
excerpt: What fails when you add C++ code to an ament_cmake package: uncrustify diffs fixed by --reformat, Jazzy-formatted code failing on Humble, cpplint copyright errors including the generated my_node.cpp, xmllint failing offline, and the ways to skip a linter. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
